تقترفون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِفُونَ (taqtarifūna) /taq.ta.ri.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# تُقْتَرَفُونَ (tuqtarafūna) /tuq.ta.ra.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
